muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīrī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past).
﴿نشرح﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "We" (نحن).
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نشرح﴾.
﴿صدرك﴾: «صدر» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ألم نشرح﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ووضعنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and «وضعنا» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the pronoun is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ووضعنا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ألم نشرح﴾.
﴿عنك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وضعنا﴾.
﴿وزرك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وزرك﴾.
﴿أنقض﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "it" (هو).
﴿ظهرك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿أنقض﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ورفعنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and «رفعنا» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the pronoun is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); «رفعنا» is conjoined to ﴿ألم نشرح﴾.
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رفعنا﴾.
﴿ذكرك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle.
﴿مع﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿العسر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿يسرا﴾: the postponed noun (ism) of «إن», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the overt fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle.
﴿مع﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿العسر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿يسرا﴾: the postponed noun (ism) of «إن»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to something implied that the context calls for, or the wāw [Translator's note: so in the source; the word begins with a fāʾ] is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إذا» is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the answer.
﴿فرغت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿فرغت﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb being annexed to it.
﴿فانصب﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and «انصب» is an imperative verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿و﴾: conjunctive.
﴿إلى ربك﴾: «إلى» is a preposition and the word ﴿رب﴾ is a noun in the genitive (majrūr), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ارغب﴾.
﴿فارغب﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa) and «ارغب» is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
